analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation edit to docs/architecture/inference.md at line 1353 (the gpt_oss row in the model_type table). It adds a note that a bf16 checkpoint keeps bf16 activations and native K/V on every layer, because the expert SwiGLU clamps with scalar bounds that take the activation dtype, citing libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GPTOSS+Experts.swift (`swiglu`). The patch touches no code, configuration, or wire/protocol behavior. No change to any trust boundary: TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 and TB-011 are unaffected, and the prefix-cache threat T-041 and its encrypted SSD tier are unchanged. The edit does not alter the attestation, App Attest authorization, key custody, cache scoping, TTL or lookup-tag controls, and it introduces no new attack surface. The excerpt of the head file shows only lines 1-415, so the changed line itself is covered by the patch excerpt rather than the numbered head text. The patch is marked complete. The claim about the dtype behavior of the cited source file is not verifiable from the supplied evidence, but it is documentation of an implementation detail and not a security control. The remaining integration question is only whether the described dtype behavior matches the code, which is a correctness concern outside the threat model.
